_about: Design styles for explainers and motion graphics: a palette, a font pairing, a short style guide and a matching caption preset.

clean-saas.label: Clean SaaS
clean-saas.style_guide: Lots of white space, rounded 16px cards with soft shadows, UI screenshots in device frames. Motion: slide and fade, 10 to 14 frames, small stagger. One accent per scene.

dark-tech.label: Dark Tech
dark-tech.style_guide: Near-black backgrounds, glowing accent lines, grid textures at 4% opacity, monospace labels for numbers. Motion: snappy springs, glow pulses, scanline sweeps.

editorial.label: Editorial
editorial.style_guide: Magazine layout: serif headlines, small uppercase kickers with wide tracking, thin rules, photos with generous margins. Motion: mask wipes and slow pushes, no bounce.

playful-pop.label: Playful Pop
playful-pop.style_guide: Chunky shapes, thick 4px outlines, flat colors, stickers and emoji-style icons. Motion: elastic pops with overshoot, wiggles on emphasis, confetti on wins.

corporate-trust.label: Corporate Trust
corporate-trust.style_guide: Navy and blue, clean icons, charts with clear labels and sources. Motion: calm ease-out, no overshoot, 12 to 16 frame entrances.

warm-story.label: Warm Story
warm-story.style_guide: Documentary feel: warm grade, film grain, hand-drawn underlines, archival photos with slow Ken Burns. Motion: gentle drifts and dissolves.

bold-creator.label: Bold Creator
bold-creator.style_guide: Huge condensed uppercase type, yellow highlights, hard cuts, punch-in zooms on key words. Motion: fast (6 to 8 frame) snaps, impact shakes on numbers.

edu-chalk.label: Edu Chalk
edu-chalk.style_guide: Chalkboard teaching style: hand-drawn diagrams that draw on, arrows and circles for emphasis, step numbering. Motion: stroke draw-ons and simple fades, one idea per scene.
